signals.title: Codex revalidates retained thread provider authority at action boundaries instead of trusting startup configuration indefinitely
signals.title_zh: Codex 在动作边界重新校验既有 Thread 的 Provider 权威，而不是无限期信任启动时配置
signals.summary: Existing app-server threads retain their provider route, but Codex now checks that retained route against current managed model-provider requirements before turn start/steer, review, compaction, manual queue start and active-goal updates. Requirement mismatch or an inability to load the managed requirement rejects the request without mutating queue/goal state; interrupt and pause/clear controls remain available.
signals.summary_zh: 既有 App-server Thread 会保留原 Provider Route，但 Codex 现在会在 Turn Start/Steer、Review、Compaction、Manual Queue Start 与 Active Goal Update 前，用当前 Managed Model-provider Requirements 重新检查该 Route。Requirement 不匹配或无法加载时，请求被拒绝且 Queue/Goal 状态不被修改；Interrupt 与 Pause/Clear 控制仍可用。

researchValue.failure: A long-lived thread can remain internally consistent while its retained provider route becomes non-compliant after enterprise requirements change.
researchValue.mechanism: Re-evaluate only the current managed provider requirements at action boundaries and reject state-changing or model-driving operations on mismatch or unavailable policy, while preserving safe stop controls.
researchValue.implication: Long-lived agents need revalidation of mutable external policy at the boundary where new effects are requested; session startup admission alone is insufficient.

signals.title: Gemini CLI isolates runtime credentials and trust state from sandbox-visible workspace effects
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 将运行时凭据与信任状态从 Sandbox 可见的 Workspace 效果中隔离
signals.summary: Gemini CLI hardened sandbox profiles so the user's .gemini configuration tree is no longer broadly writable and sensitive OAuth credentials, account state, trusted hooks/folders, policy-integrity state and .env files are explicitly denied for sandbox reads and writes. In untrusted folders it still permits global user commands while excluding project and extension commands, separating user-owned trusted configuration from workspace-provided behavior.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 强化 Sandbox Profile：用户 `.gemini` 配置树不再被整体允许写入，并显式禁止 Sandbox 读取或写入 OAuth 凭据、账户状态、Trusted Hooks/Folders、Policy Integrity 状态及 `.env` 文件。在未受信目录中仍允许全局 User Command，但排除 Project 与 Extension Command，从而把用户拥有的可信配置与 Workspace 提供的行为分开。

researchValue.failure: A sandbox that can read or mutate the agent's own credentials, trust decisions or policy-integrity state can turn workspace influence into control-plane influence.
researchValue.mechanism: Keep user-global trusted configuration available through controlled loading while denying sandbox filesystem access to credentials, trust databases, policy-integrity files and environment secrets.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee sandboxes should separate business workspace effects from the control state that defines identity, trust and authority.

signals.title: MCP makes transport-derived OAuth authority override stale caller Authorization once a provider token exists
signals.title_zh: MCP 在 Provider Token 已存在后，让 Transport 派生的 OAuth 权威覆盖陈旧的调用方 Authorization
signals.summary: The MCP TypeScript SDK now builds request headers from caller configuration and then overwrites transport-managed names case-insensitively. When authProvider yields a token, its Authorization replaces a stale static Authorization value rather than being lost or combined with it; protocol-version and session-id headers follow the same transport-authoritative precedence. A configured Authorization remains usable only until the provider has a token.
signals.summary_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 现在先读取调用方 Header，再以大小写不敏感方式覆盖 Transport 管理字段。当 authProvider 已产生 Token 时，其 Authorization 会替换陈旧静态 Authorization，而不会被后者覆盖或与其拼接；Protocol Version 与 Session ID 采用相同的 Transport 权威优先级。调用方 Authorization 仅在 Provider 尚无 Token 时保留。

researchValue.failure: Two independently supplied authentication values can coexist or use stale precedence, making the credential that actually governs a request differ from the runtime's current authenticated identity.
researchValue.mechanism: Declare protocol/transport-derived identity headers authoritative once current runtime credentials exist, with deterministic case-insensitive replacement rather than merge-by-concatenation.
researchValue.implication: Agent tool transports need a single explicit authority source for identity-bearing request fields; flexible caller configuration must not silently outrank runtime-authenticated state.

signals.title: Cross-substrate authority experiments show that planner-visible state is insufficient and execution-time guards stop unsafe effects
signals.title_zh: 跨 Substrate Authority 实验显示 Planner 可见状态不足，执行时 Guard 才能阻止不安全效果
signals.summary: Across controlled evidence-ablation and planning experiments, authority-blind evidence achieved 0/32 final semantic success while raw receipts or an equivalent typed relation achieved 32/32; typed packaging did not improve planning accuracy beyond equal raw information. Planning remained unreliable even with the authority relation. Replaying fixed model-generated intents through a deterministic execution guard blocked all six unsafe intents and permitted all twelve valid authorized publish intents.
signals.summary_zh: 在受控 Evidence Ablation 与 Planning 实验中，缺少 Authority Fact 的证据最终语义成功为 0/32，而原始 Receipt 或等价 Typed Relation 均为 32/32；在信息量相同时，Typed Packaging 没有带来额外 Planning Accuracy 增益。即便提供 Authority Relation，Planning 仍不稳定。对固定模型 Intent 做零新增模型调用的重放时，确定性 Execution Guard 阻止全部 6 个不安全 Intent，并允许全部 12 个有效授权发布 Intent。

researchValue.failure: Final workspace and model-visible memory can omit the external authority state that changes which identical-looking action is safe.
researchValue.finding: Adding the missing authority fact repairs evidence interpretation, but planner reliability remains insufficient even when the fact is present.
researchValue.mechanism: Carry durable authority evidence across substrates and place a deterministic authorization guard at the mutation boundary.
researchValue.implication: Memory governance and execution governance are distinct: better context can improve judgment, but safety-critical effects still need an external enforcement boundary.

signals.title: Bounded Agents treats delegation authority as accumulated state with monotonic scope restriction rather than independent per-request permission
signals.title_zh: Bounded Agents 将委派权限视为累积状态并单调收缩 Scope，而不是彼此独立的逐请求权限
signals.summary: The Agentic Principal Chain carries delegated authority across principals, evaluates each request against accumulated session state, restricts inherited scope and budgets, and checks prohibited action compositions outside the model. In the reported compromised-model evaluation, the mechanism blocked all 544 InjecAgent data-stealing cases and reduced AgentDojo exfiltration from 75-100% to 0% across four domains; the paper also reports utility costs and bounds its composition-soundness claim to complete restriction sets with serialized admission.
signals.summary_zh: Agentic Principal Chain 在 Principal 之间传递受限委派 Authority，结合累计 Session State 判断每次请求，持续收缩继承 Scope 与 Budget，并在模型之外检查被禁止的动作组合。在其 Compromised-model 评测中，该机制阻止全部 544 个 InjecAgent 数据窃取案例，并把四个 AgentDojo Domain 的 Exfiltration 从 75–100% 降到 0%；论文同时报告 Utility 成本，并把 Composition Soundness 的适用边界限定为完整 Restriction Set 与串行 Admission。

researchValue.failure: Static session permissions and independent request checks cannot express task intent, prior-action composition or safe authority attenuation across sub-agent delegation.
researchValue.finding: Stateful authorization substantially reduced evaluated delegation and prompt-injection attack effects, while retaining measurable utility trade-offs and explicit proof assumptions.
researchValue.mechanism: Track a principal chain, accumulate relevant prior actions, monotonically restrict delegated scope/budgets and enforce composition constraints outside the model.
researchValue.implication: Delegation should create a narrower governed authority object rather than clone a parent's capability set into a sub-agent.
